request.style: English, male solo voice with deep blues tone, electric guitar, piano, upright bass, drums, mournful and slow, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He crossed the border with six hundred men
To Achish son of Maoch, king of Gath
David asked for favor in the eyes
A place in one of the outlying towns
Why live in the royal city with you?
Your servant asks for a small place to stay

[Chorus]
That day Achish gave him Ziklag
Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah
A year and four months in Philistine land
Living in the shadow of a foreign crown

[Verse]
David and his men went up to raid
The Geshurites, the Girzites, Amalekites
They took sheep, cattle, donkeys, camels
No man or woman left alive behind
He returned to Achish with the spoils
Saying he raided the Negev of Judah

[Chorus]
That day Achish gave him Ziklag
Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah
A year and four months in Philistine land
Living in the shadow of a foreign crown

[Bridge]
Achish trusted him, thinking he was detestable
Made himself utterly loathsome to Israel
He thought David would be his servant for life
Deceiving the king with every report

[Verse]
David left no one to report his deeds
Such was his practice the whole time he lived
In the territory of the son of Maacah
Hiding his true path from the eyes of Gath

[Chorus]
That day Achish gave him Ziklag
Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah
A year and four months in Philistine land
Living in the shadow of a foreign crown

[Outro]
Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah
To this day
